result.changelog: Fixed both errors from the report. Leviathans: the Tallon IV Chozo did not all become the Turned. Many died holding back the Phazon, the survivors left the planet, and only those utterly corrupted became Chozo Ghosts. Metroid Hatcher: a single Nova Beam shot aimed through the X-Ray Visor also kills it. Checked the unverified items and made these changes: core destruction now "halts" a planet's corruption instead of "reverses" it. The PED wiki-prose quote is replaced with the Federation Data line ("harness the energy of Phazon minerals, originally discovered on Aether"). Norion's "only recorded" line is no longer quoted. The Phaaze discovery now follows the SkyTown Data account (Chozo satellite, Elysians tracing the object through a wormhole, Aurora Unit 217 disabled by a Phazon-based virus), replacing the uncited claim that AU 217 triangulated it. Dropped Phazon Puffers. Hunter and Fission Metroids are now credited to Phazon exposure, not Pirate experiments. Removed the claim that the Federation warned Samus about the PED Suit and the claim that she was the "only being to come back". The purge of Samus's Phazon is now stated, sourced to Metroid Wiki's Dark Samus page. Smaller fixes: Gandrayda was corrupted on the Pirate Homeworld rather than by overusing her PED; the 2-deca-cycle line is credited to the Omega Pirate; rift changed to wormhole; Project Titan is "suspended indefinitely"; the Valhalla fell to Phazon-powered starships plus superior numbers; corrected how the Leviathan Infant was killed and how every Leviathan was destroyed; Dark Samus's motive for the Homeworld Seed now comes from the Purification log. Added: the Pirates' 25-year estimate for Tallon IV, Omega Ridley, Phazon Elite, the Pirate Phazon virus against Aurora Units and the hunters' summons, the name Corrupt Hypermode, and the Elysians' record of the Pirate shield and the name "Seed". Keys: added Corrupt Hypermode, Infant Leviathan, Metroid Hatchers, Phaz-Ings, Phazon Grenades, Phazon virus, Phazon Elite, Vertigo strain and Phazon Suit. Dropped Hyper Beam (it clashes with Super Metroid), Phazon exposure and Phazon Strain Vertigo. Removed Anti-Phazon mentions (its page is a 404) and editorial lines. All entries are in word range (core subjects 455 and 540, others 356-398), have 8-12 keys, use order 100 and are non-constant.
result.unresolved: The 'roughly fifty years' date for the Tallon IV impact comes from the draft and was not rechecked. The Federation Data 'five decades' line may refer to Aether. Samus's purge rests on uncited Metroid Wiki prose, and Wikipedia only says Phaaze's end 'possibly' made all Phazon inert. It is not confirmed that the virus in the Federation's own Aurora Units was Phazon-based, so the summons is worded neutrally. The PED key may misfire in non-Metroid chat. The PED Suit and Phazon Suit keys overlap the suits domain, Phazon Metroids overlap the metroids domain, and Omega Ridley overlaps the Ridley domain. Anti-Phazon's role on Phaaze is omitted.
